text_block_list.text: —The day of the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The field heads into the fourth corner! 
Holy Cure! Here comes Holy Cure charging 
in!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Go, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sol Lapis! Followed by Holy Cure!! From 
the outside, Waltz of Shadow is charging 
hard as well!
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text:
“――――Haaaaaaah!!!!” “――――Daaaaaaah!!!!” 
“――――Yaaaaaaah!!!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Holy Cure!! Sol Lapis!!! Holy Cure crosses 
the finish line by a hair!!
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Alright...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—And the 'Four Heavenly Kings' sweep the 
top three!! It's a one-two-three finish!!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I got super excited too...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Not just how the race went, but the sheer 
frenzy of the crowd was directed at 
everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! The "Big Four" are insane!! Now I'm 
super hyped for next year's Classic 
races...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Are we really getting a showdown where 
the 'Four Heavenly Kings' compete for the 
Triple Crown...!? If so, that's insanely 
hype!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...! Honestly, that makes me super 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Besides... that's what crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I really do want to compete in races with 
everyone! I mean—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I want all four of us Heavenly Kings to 
create an even bigger, grander wave of 
excitement...!
choice_data_list:
...I'm sure it'll come true at the Satsuki 
Sho and the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I can't wait...!

And starting from this Hopeful Stakes, the 
spotlight of race fans suddenly shifted 
all at once to the "Four Heavenly Queens"—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
――So for your Classic year, the Satsuki 
Sho will indeed be your first goal!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm currently making adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"What are your thoughts on the possibility 
of the Four Heavenly Kings facing off in 
the Satsuki Sho?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: If that happens, I'd be so happy!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"We're childhood friends, but at the same 
time, we're rivals. Everyone has always 
dreamed of competing on the grandest 
stage...!"

...Interview requests for Bubble Gum 
Fellow have been rapidly increasing 
lately.

From what I hear, all of the "Four 
Heavenly Kings" are in this state right 
now. Truly, one could say the whirlwind of 
the Four Heavenly Kings is beginning—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Pheww! That was quite a lot of interviews 
for today. Thanks to that, the sun has 
really gone down.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Can I do just one lap for now? I really 
want to run at least that much.
choice_data_list:
You're not in top form yet, so take it 
easy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm off!

Bubble Gum Fellow dashed off in an 
instant. Following her with my eyesâ
—Hah!!

Someone streaked past where they had just 
been at high speed, rushing after Bubble 
Gum Fellow.

Due to the setting sun, it's hard to tell 
who the black shadow pursuing Bubble Gum 
Fellow is. However, their speed is 
immense...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Kh, who is that...!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Hey there, Bubble!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fuji!? Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a surprise—let's run together for a 
bit. —Come on, let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what you're planning, but―― 
I'm not about to give up the lead so 
easily!

The figures of the two waver as if 
ignited, and immediately after, they 
accelerate. It was like a training duel 
with the intensity of a real race—

Second. A profound sense of discomfort 
sets in.

First is that Bubble Gum Fellow's running 
seems in good shape at a glance, but 
somehow feels different than usual.
The other one is—

...From a distance, the running form of 
Bubble Gum Fellow and the intruder looked 
remarkably similar.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nicely done, Bubble! Looks like you've 
grown even more powerful.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I was surprised, but running 
alongside you was fun.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what brought this on all of a 
sudden? Knowing Fuji, I'm sure she has 
something in mind, but—"

"...The intruder's name was Fuji Kiseki. 
An Umamusume who debuted one year before 
Bubble Gum Fellow, and—"

After making his debut, he notched four 
consecutive unstoppable victories. Among 
them was the Asahi Hai FS, where Bubble 
Gum Fellow also ran.

With her dashing running style and sheer 
power, many believed she could become a 
Triple Crown Umamusume, but—

"...This spring, right on the verge of the 
Classic races, she went on an indefinite 
hiatus due to leg issues."

Many racing fans still lament the fact 
that she was unable to run in the Classic 
races...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Running with you made me realize. You're 
growing at an incredible pace right now."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Just like how I was, not too long ago.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's not a fun topic worth building 
suspense over, after all. Let me just cut 
straight to the conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Bubble. At this rate, you might not be 
able to run in the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
......That's an unusual look on your face. 
Does that mean you're really that serious 
about this—?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! That's what I came for, after 
all. ...Though, maybe we should change 
locations.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble's Trainer, when you watched me and 
Bubble run side-by-side, did you feel 
anything?
choice_data_list:
...I did think the vibe when you run felt 
similar.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's right. Exactly as you say.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Bubble and I may have some minor 
differences in our running styles, but 
deep down, they're fundamentally very 
similar.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Explosive power born from flexible 
muscles, alongside silky smooth 
acceleration. And explosive burst in the 
final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A physical trait that shows its true worth 
when it comes to speed... That is the 
shared strength between Bubble and me.

...Fuji Kiseki's words ring true. What she 
speaks of matches precisely with my own 
understanding of Bubble Gum Fellow's 
strengths.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"And perhaps... just like their strengths, 
they share a common weakness."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――...My right leg, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Bubble. When you were running just now, 
did you feel even the slightest bit of 
pain?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: No, there's no pain.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I suppose I did find myself 
paying attention to it. It strangely 
caught my eye, or rather—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You should get that looked at right away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if there's no pain, it's highly 
likely that serious damage has already 
accumulated.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Didn't you have a faint inkling, 
Trainer? Did anything feel off during that 
tandem run just now?

During that earlier tandem run, I 
definitely felt something was off with 
Bubble Gum Fellow's running. If what Fuji 
Kiseki said is true, then that means—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
......Was that how it was for you too, 
Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...You said it earlier, Bubble. We likely 
share a common weakness."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is... refusing to be subservient to 
pain.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You see, we can easily unlock the gate to 
our limits— a gate that pain is supposed 
to keep chained shut."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A thirst for victory. A surging fighting 
spirit. Or perhaps driven simply by a 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At times, it produces astonishing speed, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because she was so unyielding to pain, the 
cost quietly piled up unnoticed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A moment ago, you said 'there is no 
pain.' Yet at the same time, you mentioned 
something felt off with your leg."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......I've experienced that same feeling 
before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And... "It doesn't hurt, and I can run. 
There's no problem." That was what I ended 
up thinking—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...And the result is who I am today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fuji...—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—From your debut race all the way to the 
Asahi Hai FS, your running was truly 
memorable, and I felt a certain sympathy 
toward it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I believe this from 
the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't want you to end up like 
me, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list:
Let's get you a thorough medical checkup 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
………………You're right. I'll make sure to 
check my condition properly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, both of you.

Afterward, we immediately conducted a 
detailed medical examination on Bubble Gum 
Fellow, and—

Just as Fuji Kiseki had feared, it turned 
out race fatigue had been accumulating in 
Bubble Gum Fellow's right leg.

A few days later, during a discussion with 
Bubble Gum Fellow regarding her future 
training plan—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Then going forward, I suppose I'll 
prioritize recovering my right leg while 
feeling out my own personal limits.
choice_data_list:
Right. It's training with limiters 
attached.

Right. It's training with limiters 
attached, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
To prevent her from accidentally pushing 
beyond her limits and suffering fatal 
damage, I must establish a clear limiter 
for her.

"By doing so, we will ensure that Bubble 
Gum Fellow's path is never cut short in 
the future...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to run the Classic races too. 
And even beyond that, I want to run so 
much more—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So I will definitely seize it! I'll prove 
that I can control my own limits...!

And so, our new course of action leading 
up to the Satsuki Sho was set—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fuji-senpai, goood morning!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, little pony. Thank you for 
such a lovely, energetic greeting.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Fuji.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the other day. Thanks to you... 
I think the worst was avoided.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I make a declaration.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"With my running from here on out, I'll 
definitely repay this debt. I'll get 
results in the Classic races for Fuji's 
sake, too. So—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fuji, you should come back soon too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm a failure as an entertainer, aren't I? 
To be the one getting cheered up instead—

Spring is still far away. Yet, that step 
surely leads forward—
